purpose: Deterministic Teacher-v3 enrichment plus seeded stratified controls for identity-visible human morphology review with model and selection annotations withheld
unit: one successful rank-one DET_FLUX_ADP_SML candidate per unique TIC, with rank-one DET_FLUX_ADP context

cohort_evaluation.repeated_host: Model-ready S63 TICs present in the frozen Teacher-v3 morphology corpus
cohort_evaluation.independence_rule: Compute every percentile and selection score independently within each complete cohort before any bucket depletion

broad_duty_cycle_percentile.population: all validated unique-TIC candidates in the current cohort before any bucket depletion
broad_duty_cycle_percentile.tie_rule: equal duty cycles receive their average one-based rank divided by cohort size

deterministic_bucket_selection.descriptive_cut_fraction: bucket quota divided by the remaining unique-TIC pool size immediately before that deterministic bucket; descriptive only, never a sampling probability or prevalence weight

control_selection.population: unique TICs remaining in the cohort after all five deterministic buckets
control_selection.tie_rule: rank(method='first') so equal SDE values are ordered by ascending TIC
control_selection.qcut_algorithm: pandas qcut of the first-ranked SDE values into exactly four integer quartiles labeled 1,2,3,4; duplicate edges or fewer than four strata fail closed
control_selection.draw_allocation: floor(control_quota/4) per quartile, with one additional draw assigned in quartile order 1,2,... for the control_quota modulo 4 remainder
control_selection.within_stratum_order: ascending lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the ASCII string '{seed}|{cohort}|control|q{stratum}|{tic}'
control_selection.inclusion_probability: realized stratum draw count divided by stratum population
control_selection.selection_weight: stratum population divided by realized stratum draw count

combined_queue_order.algorithm: ascending lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the ASCII string '{seed}|combined-review-order|{tic}'
combined_queue_order.scope: The seeded order itself does not encode an explicit cohort or bucket annotation; visible TIC identity remains externally joinable

shortage_policy: Fail closed before publication if any exact deterministic bucket or control-stratum draw cannot be filled; never backfill across buckets, strata, or cohorts

erratum_to_prospective_plan.interpretation: The original wording means explicit cohort annotation is withheld; TIC and candidate identity remain visible and technically joinable to the frozen Teacher-v3 corpus

blinding.review_completion: All 1100 frozen rows require an accepted human morphology decision before one-time unblinding and cohort-wise analysis
